notes.title: Polar Pathways Demo Release!
notes.notes:
☃️ It's official, our Demo is on Steam to stay! ☃️

🐧 We've iterated and testing our demo with developers and players alike, and we're so proud and happy with how it is. 🐧

❄️ You can download it right now and explore the penguin village with all its quirks and cute characters our demo has to offer.

Waddle and slide around the penguin village as you interact with penguins in need and explore the arctic landscape freely with no pressure or constraints before the sun sets for the day.❄️

✨Thank you so much for your support and feedback, we hope you enjoy playing it as much as we enjoy making it ✨
